findings.message: The user maps the curly-haired man on the left to Daniel Soriano, the museum conservator, and the long-haired man on the right to Tomas Rivera, the Cafe Siete baker.
Approved appearance scope is adult facial identity, hair, build, age impression, Daniel's glasses, shared scale and visual chemistry.

Tomas's pictured sleeve construction is not authoritative. Preserve the approved manuscript specification: cream long-sleeved 1980s cafe shirt rolled to the elbows with faint collar embroidery and a jade-green hair cord.
Do not promote the depicted pose, environment, rain, props, clocks, dates, signs, newspaper copy, title text or lettering into story or production authority.
The WebP preserves the exact user-supplied bytes. The PNG is a 1024 x 1536 format-derived working master with a separate hash-bound approval.
